title: Uruguayan Beef Wrap
description: A twist on traditional Mexican wraps, this recipe features Uruguayan seasoned beef and roasted vegetables.

ingredients.name: Roasted red bell pepper
ingredients.notes: Roasted in the oven at 400°F (200°C) until charred

ingredients.name: Roasted onion
ingredients.notes: Roasted in the oven at 400°F (200°C) until caramelized

ingredients.name: Roasted zesty corn
ingredients.notes: Roasted in the oven at 400°F (200°C) until lightly browned

instructions: Roast the red bell pepper, onion, and zesty corn in the oven for 20 minutes.
Season the beef with Uruguayan seasoning and cook in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned.
Warm the corn tortilla wrap in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the wrap by placing the beef, roasted vegetables, shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, and sliced avocado inside the tortilla.
